verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents a strong reconciliation report suite (Balance Breakdown, Financial Actions by Payout ID, Payouts Report, Settlement Breakdown/Statement) that maps payouts to underlying charges, fees, and financial actions, satisfying the 'see exactly what makes up each payout' half of the story. However, there is no evidence of finance-ops controlling the payout schedule itself (e.g., setting payout frequency/cadence, minimum thresholds, or on-demand payout triggers) — the docs focus on reporting/reconciliation, not schedule configuration. missing for 10: documentation of configurable payout schedule/frequency settings, UI/API control over payout timing or triggering ad-hoc payouts, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the reconciliation reports' accuracy in practice.
